sql: with last_tick as (select distinct on (t.live_order_id) t.live_order_id, lo.strategy, lo.status, t.features_json f, t.contracts_ahead ahead from live_order_queue_ticks t join live_orders lo on lo.id=t.live_order_id where lo.strategy in ('Fmmsell10','Alimm1') and lo.status in ('filled','canceled') and lo.created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-16 11:00:00+00' order by t.live_order_id, t.captured_at desc), j as (select strategy, status, (f->>'qty_at_our_price')::float qty_our, (f->>'qty_better')::float qty_better, ahead from last_tick) select strategy, 'a_control_all' grp, count(*)::text n, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text fill_pct from j group by strategy union all select strategy, 'b_company_at_price', count(*)::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from j where qty_our>0 group by strategy union all select strategy, 'c_no_better_ahead', count(*)::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from j where qty_better=0 group by strategy union all select strategy, 'd_STACKED b+c', count(*)::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from j where qty_our>0 and qty_better=0 group by strategy union all select strategy, 'e_queue_front (<=50)', count(*)::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from j where ahead<=50 group by strategy union all select strategy, 'f_queue_deep (>500)', count(*)::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from j where ahead>500 group by strategy order by 1,2
